explanation: Logistic Sequence - This is a Machine Learning approach using Logistic Regression trained on sequence features (like streak counts and recent directions) to predict the next move. It operates with signal parameters such as feature_window_set=[5, 10, 20], C=0.1, class_weight=balanced, prediction_threshold=0.58, min_prob_gap=0.1. To control risk, it halts trading after 3 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 6 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 2 units. It dynamically stops trading after excessive continuous market streaks to avoid severe drawdowns.
